text_blocks.snippet: The official corporate website for the State Bank of India is State Bank of India (migrated from sbi.co.in).

list.snippet: Personal Banking & Services: Access retail banking and services at Personal Banking.
Internet Banking (Retail): Log in to your personal account via Online SBI Internet Banking or onlinesbi.sbi.bank.in.
Corporate Banking: Access business accounts at Corporate Internet Banking.
Careers & Recruitment: View official job openings at SBI Careers.
Customer Support: Find helpline numbers and contact details at SBI Customer Care or call the 24/7 toll-free helpline at 1800 1234 or 1800 2100.
